detailedServices.name: Filler & Botox Injections
detailedServices.description: Precise injections to soften lines, contour the face, and enhance lip shape with natural results.

detailedServices.name: Laser Hair Removal
detailedServices.description: Certified laser systems suitable for all skin types, with quick, safe sessions.

detailedServices.name: Skin Brightening & Glow
detailedServices.description: Targeted protocols to even out skin tone using medically certified actives.

detailedServices.name: Deep Cleansing & HydraFacial
detailedServices.description: Deep-cleansing sessions that restore radiance and stimulate skin renewal.

detailedServices.name: Acne Treatment
detailedServices.description: Comprehensive plans for active acne and post-acne marks led by a consultant.

detailedServices.name: Non-Surgical Body Sculpting
detailedServices.description: Fat-reduction and skin-tightening technologies — no surgery, no downtime.

faq.question: Are filler and Botox results safe and natural?
faq.answer: We use FDA-approved products injected by consultants, with a strong focus on results that complement your natural features.

faq.question: How long is a laser session?
faq.answer: Sessions range from 15 to 45 minutes depending on the area, and usually require no downtime.

faq.question: When do skin-care results show?
faq.answer: Initial results appear after the first session and continue to improve over 2–4 weeks.

faq.question: Do you offer free initial consultations?
faq.answer: Yes — your first skin-assessment consultation is complimentary with a booked appointment.

faq.question: How can I book quickly?
faq.answer: The fastest way is via WhatsApp — our team responds within minutes and finds the time that suits you.

realResults.subtitle: Actual photos from MediCare patients (with their consent)
realResults.disclaimer: Results vary from person to person — photos shared with patient consent

surgery.heroDescription: A complete surgical unit with state-of-the-art operating rooms and certified surgeons — general, cosmetic, and precision surgery with trusted outcomes.

detailedServices.name: General Surgery
detailedServices.description: Abdominal, hernia, colon, and vascular procedures performed by consultants.

detailedServices.name: Plastic Surgery
detailedServices.description: Rhinoplasty, liposuction, and breast procedures with harmonious results.

detailedServices.name: Orthopedic Surgery
detailedServices.description: Fracture care, fixation, and joint replacement using the latest techniques.

detailedServices.name: Post-Op Care Unit
detailedServices.description: Fully equipped recovery suites monitored by our medical team 24/7.

detailedServices.name: Wide Insurance Coverage
detailedServices.description: We accept most major insurance networks with a dedicated approval team.

detailedServices.name: Pre-Op Evaluation
detailedServices.description: Comprehensive testing and anesthesia consult before scheduling the procedure.

faq.question: How is the right surgery determined?
faq.answer: It starts with a surgeon consultation, review of your medical history, and tests before proposing the most suitable surgical plan.

faq.question: Are the operating rooms built to international standards?
faq.answer: Yes, our ORs follow global sterilization and monitoring protocols and use state-of-the-art equipment.

faq.question: How long is recovery, typically?
faq.answer: It depends on the procedure; you'll receive a clear recovery schedule with follow-up appointments.

faq.question: Do you accept medical insurance?
faq.answer: We accept most major insurance networks, and our team handles the approval process with your provider.

faq.question: What should I do before surgery?
faq.answer: You'll receive a complete preparation guide covering fasting, medications, and home preparations.

audiology.heroDescription: Accurate diagnosis of hearing disorders, hearing-aid fitting and tuning with the latest global technologies — for all ages.

detailedServices.name: Comprehensive Hearing Tests
detailedServices.description: Detailed hearing assessment for all ages using the latest measurement systems.

detailedServices.name: Hearing-Aid Fitting
detailedServices.description: Latest hearing-aid technology in comfortable, custom forms.

detailedServices.name: Senior Care Consultations
detailedServices.description: Personalised hearing-rehab plans for seniors with ongoing follow-up.

detailedServices.name: Pediatric Hearing Screening
detailedServices.description: Early detection of childhood hearing issues to support speech development.

detailedServices.name: Maintenance & Tuning
detailedServices.description: Fast service to keep your hearing aid performing at its best.

faq.question: How long is a hearing test?
faq.answer: Typically 30 to 45 minutes, including several measurements for an accurate diagnosis.

faq.question: Are your hearing aids discreet?
faq.answer: We offer a wide range including near-invisible and in-canal models for those who prefer them.

faq.question: Do I need a referral before testing?
faq.answer: No — you can book directly via WhatsApp or call us.

faq.question: Do the hearing aids come with a warranty?
faq.answer: Yes, all devices include a manufacturer warranty with follow-up from our specialist team.

faq.question: Do you offer in-home consultations for seniors?
faq.answer: We offer advisory services for seniors — reach out to our team to arrange the best option.
